title: Size of a combined circuit
statement: For any number $n$ of variables, any Boolean gate type, and any finite list $cs$ of Boolean circuit trees on those variables, the size of the circuit obtained by combining the list is at most the sum of the sizes of the circuits in $cs$, plus the length of $cs$, plus $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
